# ORVN Labs — ORREI

> ORVN Labs builds software for how real estate gets presented. ORREI is its product:
> a workspace where a property record becomes an editable description, a printable deal
> sheet, a buyer summary and a published property page linked to a professional profile.
> AI assists with wording; a person approves every fact and decides what publishes.
> ORREI is in development and early access is by request.

ORVN Labs is a small software company. ORREI is the product name; ORVN Labs is the
company name. The site is light (bone and white) with a dark pine footer and lime
accents. Contact: hello@orvnlabs.com.

## ORREI in brief

- Professional presence: a business page with who you are, the markets you serve and
  your contact details.
- Property record: one record per property, holding the facts, photographs and files
  you have approved, with the source of each fact.
- Outputs: a property page with a share link, an A4 deal sheet you print or save as
  PDF, a plain-text buyer summary, and a portfolio card.
- Visibility: private, link only or public. Link only is unlisted, not confidential:
  the page opens for anyone with the link and stays out of search results.
- Responsible AI: drafting uses approved, public facts only. You review each fact and
  accept or discard the wording. ORREI does not verify real-estate facts automatically.
- Activity: the first release records that a published page was opened and stores the
  inquiries people choose to send. Anonymous visitors are not identified.
- Status: in development, invitation only. No pricing has been announced. Screens and
  sample listings on the site are illustrative.

## ORVN Labs facts

- Company: ORVN Labs.
- Product: ORREI.
- Audience: wholesalers and small disposition teams first, then agents, brokers,
  developers and investors.
- No public pricing, no customer counts and no performance claims are published.
